facets.name: overview
facets.label: Overview
facets.describes: What this area of the business is for, in a paragraph somebody outside it can follow.

facets.name: terms
facets.label: Terms
facets.describes: The words this area uses, and what each one means here. One row per word.

facets.name: rules
facets.label: Rules
facets.describes: What must hold here. One heading per rule, with somewhere it came from so it can be checked against its source.

facets.name: invariants
facets.label: Invariants
facets.describes: What must never happen. The same Fact Kind as a Rule and held to a higher bar, because an invariant nobody has corroborated twice is not yet enough to build on.
